intro: Lesson 15: Sahih, hasan, da'if and mawdu': how scholars graded reports. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: 1) Is there a collection and number? No. 2) Check with a teacher or trusted source: scholars of hadith grade this report as very weak or fabricated. 3) So I must not say 'the Prophet ﷺ said'. 4) Reply kindly with an authentic alternative.
